content.short: Stablecoin financial platform with corporate cards, payouts, invoicing and an AI finance assistant.
content.description: Infini gives borderless companies and individuals one account for holding USDT and USDC, sending wires, paying bills, issuing payment links and earning yield. Its stablecoin corporate cards are built for SaaS, API and ad spend, funded straight from a crypto treasury with budget controls, and an AI assistant helps with bookkeeping. It serves over 100,000 users in 180+ countries.
content.meta: Run business payments, stablecoin corporate cards and invoicing from one Infini account, with AI help on accounting.
